Positive Data / Momentum

15 of 69

Programs with genuinely positive recent data and forward motion.

Eli Lilly

POSITIVE DATA / MOMENTUM
Retatrutide, orforglipron, eloralintideGLP-1/GIP/amylin-class (via weight loss)
Retatrutide's OA data was the field's best recent news: positive Phase 3 topline in Dec 2025 (WOMAC pain improved ~75% vs. ~40% placebo), with a single BLA covering obesity + sleep apnea + knee OA planned for Q1 2027. That filing now carries added regulatory risk: Lilly and the FDA are still litigating whether retatrutide legally qualifies as a biologic at all (12-yr vs. 5-yr exclusivity), with oral arguments set for Sept 24, 2026 — about six months before the targeted filing. Orforglipron and eloralintide's own OA readouts aren't due until 2028; a fourth asset, LY4065967, has almost no public paper trail.
BLA classification dispute unresolved, Aug 2026 Deep dive

Levicept

POSITIVE DATA / MOMENTUM
LEVI-04Anti-NGF/p75 receptor fusion protein
A differentiated take on the anti-NGF mechanism that sank tanezumab and fasinumab. Full Phase 2 results (518 patients) published in The Lancet, March 2026: met its primary endpoint at every dose, with no increased joint-safety signal. FDA accepted the IND in Jan 2026.
Phase 2 published, Mar 2026

Enlivex Therapeutics Ltd.

POSITIVE DATA / MOMENTUM New
AllocetraImmunomodulatory macrophage reprogramming therapy
Phase I/II data in knee OA showed durable pain reduction and function improvement at 6 months versus placebo, including reported avoidance of knee replacement in some patients; presented at OARSI 2025 and EULAR 2025.
Phase I/II, positive 6-month data

ICM Co. Ltd.

POSITIVE DATA / MOMENTUM New
ICM-203Intra-articular AAV gene therapy expressing Nkx3.2 to support cartilage/synovium
Interim Phase 1/2a data showed pain reduction in 6 of 8 and cartilage thickness preserved/improved in 5 of 8 low-dose subjects through Week 52, a promising early first-in-human signal presented at OARSI.
Phase 1/2a, positive interim data

TricelX Inc.

XytriXAllogeneic umbilical-cord-derived mesenchymal stem cell injection for knee OA

Phase 1/2, IND cleared 2026

Active — Data Pending

41 of 69

Programs still in active development — dosing, recruiting, or awaiting a regulatory decision. No verdict yet, or a verdict still being contested.

Biosplice

ACTIVE — DATA PENDING
Lorecivivint (SM04690)Wnt-pathway inhibitor (intra-articular)
All three pivotal Phase 3 trials missed their primary endpoint in the full patient population (2022, 2024). Biosplice filed an NDA anyway in January 2026, leaning on a long-term extension trial and post-hoc subgroup data — with no Fast Track or Breakthrough designation found. The most consequential open question on this board.
NDA filed despite misses, Jan 2026 Deep dive

Eupraxia

ACTIVE — DATA PENDING
EP-104IARExtended-release intra-articular steroid
Positive Phase 2b data (published in Lancet Rheumatology) and FDA Fast Track once made this a strong prospect. A Phase 3 was announced in Feb 2024, but no evidence of actual dosing was found, and the company now says it's “evaluating funding alternatives” — effectively on hold, seeking a partner.
On hold, seeking partner

AstraZeneca

DISCONTINUED / FAILED
MEDI7352NGF/TNF-α bispecific fusion protein
AZ's most advanced OA asset was discontinued around Q1 2025 — not a trial failure, but part of a full pain/neuroscience R&D exit. Two earlier candidates (MEDI-578, AZD1386) were dropped in the early 2010s. No musculoskeletal category remains on AZ's pipeline page.
Discontinued ~Apr 2025

Its only OA trial (Phase 1, 2014) produced no efficacy readout, and later attempts in two other indications also failed (2020, 2023). No trial of any kind registered since — effectively shelved.
Also markets: Mobic (meloxicam)

Methodology. Status is read from SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/20-F/40-F/6-K/8-K), ClinicalTrials.gov trial records, PubMed literature, and company websites/press releases — not from a company's own framing of its program. Companies marked “deep dive” were checked directly against primary SEC filing text; others were checked against public web and literature sources. Findings marked as inferred are based on absence of evidence ― e.g., an asset quietly dropped from a pipeline page ― rather than an explicit company confirmation. Full sourced timelines for every company live in the underlying project as companies/<name>/oa_profile.md. This page refreshes weekly.
